sections.name: Plan Year and Eligibility
sections.description: Benefit plan year start and end dates.

fields.label: 1st Year Start Date
fields.helpText: When will the new plan be effective?

fields.label: 1st Year End Date
fields.helpText: Typically 12 months later, but 1st year could be shorter.

fields.label: Service Time Required
fields.helpText: How long a new employee must have worked to be ELIGIBLE to enter the plan.
fields.selectOptions: Immediate Eligibility|30 Days after Hire Date|60 Days after Hire Date|90 Days after Hire Date|6 Months after Hire Date|1 Year after Hire Date

fields.label: Plan Entry Frequency
fields.helpText: After service time has been met and someone is eligible, when an the enter the plan.
fields.selectOptions: Immediately when Eligible|The 1st Paydate after Eligibility|The 1st of the month after Eligibility|The 1st day of the next Plan Year

fields.label: Min Hours Worked per Week
fields.helpText: Generally avg hours required to maintain full time status (35 hours)

fields.label: Seasonal Employee Min Months per Year
fields.helpText: If a seasonal employee, how many months of the year needed to work to be eligible (can be no greater than 6)

fields.label: Exclude Union Employees from this Plan
fields.helpText: If you have a union and they have their own plan, then likely yes, else no.

fields.label: First Paydate In Plan Year
fields.helpText: Enter the 1st date of pay after your plan year begins.

fields.label: Any Other Pay cycles
fields.helpText: Do you have any other pay cycles besides the one listed above.

sections.name: Claims Runout Period
sections.description: Runout periods, and rollover options for HRA plans.

fields.label: Runout Period After Plan Year End
fields.helpText: Amount of time after plan year ends that a participant may submit claims incurred in the prior plan year.

fields.label: Runout Period After Termination
fields.helpText: Amount of time after termination a particpant may submit claims incurred from the start of the plan year up to the date of their termination.

fields.label: Health FSA Election Limit
fields.helpText: If less than maximum, indicate amount here.

fields.label: End Of Year Feature
